item_name: Rothco Military Style Armband ID Holder
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Military Style Armband ID Holder allows for a quick and easy display of identification held visibly on your arm.
description: Rothco’s Military Style Armband ID Holder allows for a quick and easy display of identification held visibly on your arm. The identification window is fasted by hook and loop closure, and measures 4.25 Inches x 3.25 Inches, securely holding your ID or license in place. The tactical arm band ID holder’s pen holder provides easy access to a writing utensil, perfect for quickly jotting down notes. Dual adjustable elastic straps with hook and loop closures let you customize this military style ID holder to a snug fit on your arm. This hands-free ID holder is constructed with nylon and polyester for unparalleled durability.
